CLI: Version Bump : Major._readme: will update the 'patch' section of the semantic version (x.0.0)

CLI: Version Bump : Minor._readme: will update the 'patch' section of the semantic version (0.x.0)

CLI: Version Bump : Patch._readme: will update the 'patch' section of the semantic version (0.0.x)

CLI: Version Bump : Preview._readme: will update the 'preview' section of the semantic version (0.0.0-preview.x)

CLI: Version Bump : Manual._readme: useful for setting a preview for an upcoming version. Will ask for a prompt of the new version string

CLI: Download Icon._readme: downloads a png to a specific location to then be used by nuget packages as a built in icon

CLI: Update Kiota Client._readme: ONLY RUN WHEN THE SERVER IS LIVE! Updates the kiota client to the latest version

CLI: setup module._readme: Setup a new module and all of its packages

CLI: set Server Secrets._readme: Setup the server secrets, required to run the application
